coordinateSystem: Y-up; root matches existing TerracottaPot240 origin

components: three tapered bamboo stakes with physical node collars
2.3 mm jute triangular support tiers and top lashings
three-lobed cordate leaf solids with hero raised veins
blue-purple funnel corollas with pale throats
manufactureInstallation.mounting: Pair with existing TerracottaPot240; do not duplicate/fuse the pot. Soil remains inside its inner wall. Stakes intentionally penetrate soil about 78 mm below the soil top.
manufactureInstallation.interfaces: Twine contacts stakes as tied support; vines physically wrap stakes; leaves and flowers attach through modeled petioles/peduncles. No sealants.
manufactureInstallation.orientationExposure: Upright summer container plant; upper canopy sun/sky exposed, lower canopy self-shaded; dry reference state.
manufactureInstallation.agingCausality: Ordinary maintained living plant. No arbitrary scorch, damage, disaster cue, moisture streak or random dirt. Future wilt/chlorosis/dust/wetness must follow placement and maintenance history.
manufactureInstallation.geometryVsMaterial: Stake taper/nodes, twine sag, stem winding, leaf thickness/hero veins, petioles, flower funnel/lip and soil volume are geometry. Fine fibres, epidermis, venation grain and soil grains are material microstructure; no painted highlight.
manufactureInstallation.periodAccuracy: Generic unbranded bamboo/twine garden construction; no claim of reproducing an exact 1990s commercial trellis SKU.

botanicalReference.source: Kew Science Plants of the World Online
botanicalReference.usedFor: twining habit; cordate/three-lobed leaves around 8 cm; funnel corolla with pale throat and blue-purple limb; not period-product evidence
